title: Matrix Calculation in the Symplectic-Orthogonal Case
body_html:
Matrix Calculation in the Symplectic-Orthogonal Case

For \((Sp(2n),O(2n'+1))\), \(n\le n'\), choose standard matrices \(J,J'\) and identify \[ W=\operatorname{Mat}_{2n'+1,2n}. \] On the test subspace with diagonal blocks \(a=\operatorname{diag}(a_i)\) and \(b=\operatorname{diag}(b_i)\), the moment maps have diagonal blocks \[ M(w)= \begin{pmatrix} ab&0\\ 0&-ab \end{pmatrix}, \qquad M'(w)= \begin{pmatrix} ab&0&0\\ 0&0&0\\ 0&0&-ab \end{pmatrix}. \] The even orthogonal and odd orthogonal variants use the same diagonal-block calculation with the corresponding standard form matrices.
proof_html: The adjoint is \(w^*=J^{-1}w^tJ'\), so the two moment maps are \(w^*w\) and \(ww^*\). Substituting the diagonal test matrix gives the displayed blocks. The remaining split symplectic-orthogonal cases differ only in the size of the middle zero block and the parity of the orthogonal space.
